title: HealthImpact
description: HealthImpact is a lightweight Minecraft PvP Utility Mod that displays dealt damage in the action bar.
body:
HealthImpact is a lightweight Minecraft PvP utility mod that displays dealt damage in the action bar.


Open the GUI Menu by pressing **H** or through **ModMenu**

## Why should I use this mod?
- This mod helps you know if you are BreachSwapping or AttributeSwapping correctly by seeing exactly how much damage you dealt, so you never have to wonder again or need to look at the opponent's nametag (if any Health Indicator mod is enabled).

- Also helps you in NethPot by knowing if you P-Crit correctly.


**"Why should I use this mod instead of a Health Indicator mod?"**
- Health Indicator mods are **not available or allowed** on every Minecraft PvP or survival server, so this mod helps you in pvp scenarios by letting you know how much damage you dealt, allowing you to approximate how much health your opponent has left.

- More lightweight than any traditional health indicator mod, meaning no extra text to render (If you care about FPS)

**Installation Instructions:**
1. Install the **Mod**
2. Make sure you have Fabric Loader **0.19.2** or **Higher**
3. Install **Fabric API** (**Required**)
4. Install **ModMenu** (**Optional** but **Recommended**)
5. Drop all of them together into the **mods** folder 
6. Launch the game and **enjoy**!
